property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference reverts whenever _tos is empty (because it requires _tos.length > 0), while the buggy version accepts empty arrays and returns true, so the rule is: transfer must never return true for an empty recipient list.
change_summary: Changed the require at line 6 from requiring _tos.length > 0 to requiring _tos.length >= 0, removing the non-empty array guard so an empty array call returns true instead of reverting.
